notes: Stories created for MAINT-MAPS with full lifecycle coverage.

MAINT-MAPS-S1.title: Define Map Provider Data Contract
MAINT-MAPS-S1.description: Define frontend data contract for rendering providers on map including coordinates, labels, and metadata required for markers and popups.
MAINT-MAPS-S1.evidence: Website/architecture.html (frontend mapping capability referenced in manifest)

MAINT-MAPS-S2.title: Implement Map Rendering Logic
MAINT-MAPS-S2.description: Implement core logic to transform provider search results into map markers, including coordinate validation, clustering readiness, and viewport fitting.
MAINT-MAPS-S2.evidence: Website/architecture.html (frontend mapping capability referenced in manifest)

MAINT-MAPS-S3.title: Build Interactive Map UI Component
MAINT-MAPS-S3.description: Develop React-based map component to render providers, support zoom/pan, and display provider details on marker click.

MAINT-MAPS-S4.title: Integrate Map with Provider Search Results
MAINT-MAPS-S4.description: Integrate map component with existing provider search flow so that search results dynamically update map markers and viewport.

MAINT-MAPS-S5.title: Map Rendering and Interaction Test Suite
MAINT-MAPS-S5.description: Create unit and integration tests for map rendering, marker accuracy, interaction behavior, and synchronization with provider search results.

MAINT-MAPS.mitigation: Use established map libraries and limit scope to basic rendering and interaction.
